page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.24xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance powered by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Governed by the KVM hypervisor, this system delivers 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 384 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server operates without integrated GPU hardware.

Network connectivity is anchored by a 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large data transfers and clustered node operations. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local disk storage is not bundled with the server, meaning all persistent data storage and operating file systems must be supplied via attached network volumes.

Given its balanced core-to-memory ratio and 50 Gbps networking, the instance suits enterprise applications requiring high thread concurrency and steady memory density. Typical workloads include large relational and in-memory databases, continuous integration build clusters, batch processing frameworks, and high-concurrency web serving environments.
